dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: They scrubbed your memory and left you for scrap in Sector Zero. Bad call on their part. Your cyberware's still ticking, kid. Get up. We've got a city to take back.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Neural link restored. Motor control nominal. Katana synced to your spine mount. Syndicate patrols are sweeping Kuroshio Avenue.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Three Syndicate grunts dead ahead. Cheap muscle with cheap guns. Get in close and cut them down.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Patrol neutralized. Their comms went dark. Somebody upstairs will have noticed.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Warning. Cloaked signatures closing fast. Cyber-ninjas and hunter drones. Keep moving, and guard their strikes.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Ha! Ninjas folding like cheap umbrellas. You haven't lost your touch.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: Heads up. They sent a Shielded Heavy and a netrunner. Get around that shield. Don't trade hits head on.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Heavy unit down. Network intrusion purged. The Syndicate enforcer is moving to intercept.

dialogues.speaker: The Gorgon
dialogues.text: So the scrap walks. I put you in the ground once, operative. Tonight, I make sure you stay there.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: The Gorgon is overheating. Its armor is cracking. Strike now!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor Vance
dialogues.text: The Gorgon's down. Kuroshio's ours tonight. Welcome back, operative. This was only the first protocol.

dialogues.speaker: AURA
dialogues.text: Vital signs critical. Rebooting neural link. Get back on your feet, operative.
